title: Penthouse Magazine March 1986 Complete w/ Centerfold Claus Von Bulow Stockman
conditionDescription: Vintage 1986 issue. Covers clean and bright with no tears; spine intact. Light wear at the corners. Complete with centerfold. See photos.
descriptionText:
Penthouse magazine, March 1986 issue, original $3.50 cover price. Complete with centerfold.

Cover features: Special Amateur Photo Contest; Exclusive: Claus von Bulow - why he couldn't take the stand; David Stockman's bitter denunciation of the Reagan regime.

Back cover: Lucky Strike Lights cigarette ad ("Light my Lucky").

Adult collectible - sold to buyers 18+ only. See photos for condition. Ships in a plain, protective mailer.
